groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Touch People's Hearts

options.text: a positive difference in a person's life
to change your life in a significant way

sentences.full_sentence: Inspiration can create a positive difference in a person's life
sentences.translation: يمكن للإلهام أن يخلق فرقاً إيجابياً في حياة الشخص

sentences.start: Trust takes a long time to be built, but it can be destroyed
sentences.full_sentence: Trust takes a long time to be built, but it can be destroyed in no time
sentences.translation: بناء الثقة يستغرق وقتاً طويلاً، لكن يمكن تدميرها في لحظة

sentences.start: If you don't have anything positive to say
sentences.full_sentence: If you don't have anything positive to say don't say it at all
sentences.translation: إذا لم يكن لديك أي شيء إيجابي لتقوله، فلا تقل شيئاً على الإطلاق

sentences.start: You should be positive and capable
sentences.full_sentence: You should be positive and capable of inspiring others
sentences.translation: يجب أن تكون إيجابياً وقادراً على إلهام الآخرين

sentences.start: My sister and her little daughter used to
sentences.full_sentence: My sister and her little daughter used to live close to us
sentences.translation: كانت أختي وابنتها الصغيرة يعيشان بالقرب منا

groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Messages to and from Outer Space

options.text: has always been there in our minds.
they might receive from another planet.
you might wonder if anyone is really out there.
shows the existence of intelligent life in the universe.
we found that all the flights had been cancelled due to the storm.

sentences.start: If you look up at the stars,
sentences.full_sentence: If you look up at the stars, you might wonder if anyone is really out there
sentences.translation: إذا نظرت إلى النجوم، فقد تتساءل إن كان هناك أحد في الخارج

sentences.start: The desire to communicate with the outer space
sentences.full_sentence: The desire to communicate with the outer space has always been there in our minds
sentences.translation: الرغبة في التواصل مع الفضاء الخارجي كانت دائماً في أذهاننا

sentences.start: A newspaper article entitled "A Signal from Mars"
sentences.full_sentence: A newspaper article entitled "A Signal from Mars" shows the existence of intelligent life in the universe
sentences.translation: مقال في جريدة بعنوان "إشارة من المريخ" يظهر وجود حياة ذكية في الكون

sentences.full_sentence: Scientists began searching for signals they might receive from another planet
sentences.translation: بدأ العلماء بالبحث عن إشارات قد يتلقونها من كوكب آخر

sentences.full_sentence: When we reached the airport, we found that all the flights had been cancelled due to the storm
sentences.translation: عندما وصلنا إلى المطار، وجدنا أن جميع الرحلات قد ألغيت بسبب العاصفة
